lines.en: I bear the heat just long enough to ascend the stairs to the shrine and find Maya all alone in the shade from the temple, fixing her ponytail and pretending not to notice me.
lines.zh: 我顶着热气，好不容易爬上通往神社的台阶，发现 Maya 一个人待在殿宇的阴影里，整理着马尾，假装没注意到我。

lines.en: I think about shooting her some snide remark about how she should be hiding or something along those lines, but decide against it and just take my place beside her in the shade.
lines.zh: 我想冲她来句刻薄话，说她该躲起来什么的，但没有说出口，只是在阴影里站到了她旁边。

lines.en: My silence must get to her as she breaks character and speaks before I’m able to.
lines.zh: 我的沉默大概让她受不了了——她先绷不住，在我开口之前先说话了。

lines.en: What she says doesn’t matter, but it’s the fact that she says anything that makes me realize how far we’ve come despite the absence of changes in our physical relationship.
lines.zh: 她说什么不重要，重要的是她居然开口了，这让我意识到我们已经走了多远，尽管我们的肉体关系毫无进展。

lines.en: Of course that’s how it would work with her, though.
lines.zh: 不过换成她，本来就会是这样。

lines.en: Even though I’ve come to understand just what sorts of feelings she’s kept locked away all this time, I understand even more just how stubborn she is.
lines.zh: 虽然我已经明白了她一直锁在心底的是什么样的感情，我更明白她有多固执。

lines.en: And all things considered, I’m the same way.
That’s why I’m still able to bear the heat and ascend the stairs.
lines.zh: 所以我还能顶着这热气爬上台阶。

lines.en: The sun chases away the shade and we wind up having to relocate to prevent ourselves from getting sunburnt.
lines.zh: 太阳把阴影赶走了，我们不得不换个地方，免得晒伤。

lines.en: It is at this time, however, that Maya suggests I relocate to somewhere completely different as she is “tired of my presence.”
lines.zh: 而就在此时，Maya 建议我「换个完全不同的地方」，因为她「受够了我待在这儿」。

lines.en: Not feeling the need or desire to fight back this time, I oblige and immediately turn around to leave.
lines.zh: 这次我没有必要也没有欲望顶回去，于是照办，立刻转身离开。

lines.en: My actions shock her for the second time today as I’m able to hear a slight gasp escape her lips, but she does not chase after me.
lines.zh: 我的举动今天第二次让她震惊——我听见她唇间漏出一声轻微的抽气，可她没有追上来。

lines.en: She’s just too stubborn to do so.
lines.zh: 她就是固执到不会那么做。
Maya 的好感度提升到了 [maya_love]！
